task_goal: Land the lander on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (reward, individual_reward_dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact]
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine)
termination_modes: Crash: lander body contacts ground (game_over flag).
High impact velocity or large angle at ground contact.
success_like_ending: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1) while lander is near pad (x near 0, y near 0).
Low vertical and horizontal velocities at touchdown.
Low fuel consumption (m_power integrated over episode).
failure_like_endings: Crash: lander body contacts ground (game_over flag).
High impact velocity or large angle at ground contact.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the landing pad from above.
Phase 2: Controlled descent with main engine braking to reduce vertical speed.
Phase 3: Final alignment and soft touchdown with both legs contacting the pad.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing far from pad (outside pad area) but with low velocity – satisfies soft landing but misses primary objective.
Using only orientation engines to drift sideways without main engine braking – may lead to crash or out-of-bounds.
Overusing main engine causing ascent away from pad – wastes fuel and time.
